title: Jeffery Commission featured in The Northern Miner on navigating mining disputes
summary: Burford's Jeffery Commission speaks with The Northern Miner on how legal finance is helping mining companies navigate rising investor-state disputes and regulatory risk. Learn more.
body_markdown:
As geopolitical tensions and tighter oversight of critical minerals drive a rise in costly investor-state and cross-border disputes, legal finance has become a strategic tool for mining companies to fund claims, manage balance-sheet risk and unlock value from arbitration awards.


In this The Northern Miner interview,[Jeffery Commission](https://www.burfordcapital.com/about-us/our-team/jeffery-commission/) explains how legal finance works in practice, why mining has long been one of its most active sectors and what funders look for when assessing investor-state disputes in an era of rising regulatory scrutiny and enforcement challenges.


Read the full article[here](https://www.northernminer.com/digital-edition/the-northern-miner-march-2026-vol-112-issue-3/) .
